# Mixed ordinary/qualified identity: named Qual/Ord plus anonymous UseQual/UseOrd share
# spelling Name() Token. Pure Good accepted everywhere; mutating Mut accepted
# only on ordinary paths. Go wrapper w re-exports Qual/Ord; contract.Want
# checks transitive qualified identity. Both import orders plus native lgo/Go
# consumers run; attacks fail only on qualified with const_view_mutation.
# No wiring assertions; only build/run and diagnostic code are pinned.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

# Positive: wrapper builds, both orders share nominal identity, lgo/Go run.
cd sl
logos build ./...
cd ../w
logos build ./...
cd ../m
logos build -o $WORK/bin/m$GOEXE .
! stderr 'cannot use'
exec $WORK/bin/m$GOEXE
cd ../m2
logos build -o $WORK/bin/m2$GOEXE .
! stderr 'cannot use'
exec $WORK/bin/m2$GOEXE
cd ../lq
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/lq$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/lq$GOEXE
stdout '^lgo-ok$'
cd ../gq
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/gq$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/gq$GOEXE
stdout '^go-ok$'
cd ../contract
logos build ./...
cd ../cache
logos build -o $WORK/bin/cache$GOEXE .
! stderr 'cannot use'
! stderr 'const_view_mutation'
exec $WORK/bin/cache$GOEXE
cd ..

# Negative: mutating only rejected on qualified paths.
cd neg
! logos build ./qual
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./usequal
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
! logos build ./towant
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

cd gneg
! logos build ./...
stderr '\[correctness::const_view_mutation\]'
cd ..

-- sl/go.mod --
module example/sl

go 1.27

-- sl/sl.lgo --
package sl

type Token struct{ Text string }

type Qual interface {
	const Name() Token
}

type Ord interface {
	Name() Token
}

type Good struct{}

func (g Good) Name() Token { return Token{Text: "good"} }

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Name() Token {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return Token{Text: "mut"}
}

func UseQual(x interface{ const Name() Token }) Token {
	return x.Name()
}

func UseOrd(x interface{ Name() Token }) Token {
	return x.Name()
}

func NewQual() Qual {
	return Good{}
}

func NewOrd() Ord {
	return Good{}
}

func NewMutOrd() Ord {
	return Mut{S: []int{1}}
}

-- w/go.mod --
module example/w

go 1.27

require example/sl v0.0.0

replace example/sl => ../sl

-- w/w.go --
package w

import "example/sl"

type AliasQual = sl.Qual

type AliasOrd = sl.Ord

func MakeQual() sl.Qual { return sl.NewQual() }

func MakeOrd() sl.Ord { return sl.NewOrd() }

func MakeMutOrd() sl.Ord { return sl.NewMutOrd() }

-- m/go.mod --
module example/m

go 1.27

require (
	example/sl v0.0.0
	example/w v0.0.0
)

replace example/sl => ../sl

replace example/w => ../w

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example/w"
	"example/sl"
)

func main() {
	var q sl.Qual = w.MakeQual()
	var a w.AliasQual = q
	if a.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("diamond mismatch")
	}
	var o sl.Ord = w.MakeOrd()
	var ao w.AliasOrd = o
	if ao.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("ord mismatch")
	}
	var mo sl.Ord = w.MakeMutOrd()
	if mo.Name().Text != "mut" {
		panic("mutord mismatch")
	}
}

package main

	var a w.AliasQual = q
	if a.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("diamond mismatch")
	}
	var o sl.Ord = w.MakeOrd()
	var ao w.AliasOrd = o
	if ao.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("ord mismatch")
	}

		panic("mutord mismatch")
	}

-- lq/go.mod --
module example/lq

go 1.27

require example/sl v0.0.0

replace example/sl => ../sl

-- lq/q/q.lgo --
package q

import "example/sl"

func ViaQual(g sl.Good) string {
	var q sl.Qual = g
	return q.Name().Text
}

func ViaOrd(g sl.Good) string {
	var o sl.Ord = g
	return o.Name().Text
}

func ViaMutOrd(m sl.Mut) string {
	var o sl.Ord = m
	return o.Name().Text
}

func ViaUseQual(g sl.Good) string {
	return sl.UseQual(g).Text
}

func ViaUseOrd(g sl.Good) string {
	return sl.UseOrd(g).Text
}

func ViaMutUseOrd(m sl.Mut) string {
	return sl.UseOrd(m).Text
}

func Run() string {
	g := sl.Good{}
	if ViaQual(g) != "good" {
		return "bad-qual"
	}
	if ViaOrd(g) != "good" {
		return "bad-ord"
	}
	m := sl.Mut{S: []int{1}}
	if ViaMutOrd(m) != "mut" {
		return "bad-mutord"
	}
	if ViaUseQual(g) != "good" {
		return "bad-usequal"
	}
	if ViaUseOrd(g) != "good" {
		return "bad-useord"
	}
	if ViaMutUseOrd(m) != "mut" {
		return "bad-mutuseord"
	}
	return "lgo-ok"
}

-- lq/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example/lq/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Run())
}

-- gq/go.mod --
module example/gq

go 1.27

require example/sl v0.0.0

replace example/sl => ../sl

-- gq/qq/qq.go --
package qq

import "example/sl"

func Run() string {
	g := sl.Good{}
	var q sl.Qual = g
	if q.Name().Text != "good" {
		return "bad-qual"
	}
	var o sl.Ord = g
	if o.Name().Text != "good" {
		return "bad-ord"
	}
	m := sl.Mut{S: []int{1}}
	var mo sl.Ord = m
	if mo.Name().Text != "mut" {
		return "bad-mutord"
	}
	if sl.UseQual(g).Text != "good" {
		return "bad-usequal"
	}
	if sl.UseOrd(g).Text != "good" {
		return "bad-useord"
	}
	if sl.UseOrd(m).Text != "mut" {
		return "bad-mutuseord"
	}
	return "go-ok"
}

-- gq/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example/gq/qq"
)

func main() { fmt.Println(qq.Run()) }

-- contract/go.mod --
module example/contract

go 1.27

require example/sl v0.0.0

replace example/sl => ../sl

-- contract/contract.lgo --
package contract

import "example/sl"

type Want interface {
	const Name() sl.Token
}

type WantOrd interface {
	Name() sl.Token
}

-- cache/go.mod --
module example/cache

go 1.27

require (
	example/contract v0.0.0
	example/sl v0.0.0
	example/w v0.0.0
)

replace example/contract => ../contract

replace example/sl => ../sl

replace example/w => ../w

-- cache/main.go --
package main

import (
	"example/contract"
	"example/w"
)

func main() {
	var q contract.Want = w.MakeQual()
	if q.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("transitive qualified mismatch")
	}
	var o contract.WantOrd = w.MakeOrd()
	if o.Name().Text != "good" {
		panic("transitive ordinary mismatch")
	}
}

-- neg/qual/qual.lgo --
package qual

import "example/sl"

func Attack(m sl.Mut) sl.Qual {
	return m
}

-- neg/usequal/usequal.lgo --
package usequal

import "example/sl"

func Attack(m sl.Mut) sl.Token {
	return sl.UseQual(m)
}

-- neg/towant/towant.lgo --
package towant

import (
	"example/contract"
	"example/sl"
)

func Attack(o sl.Ord) contract.Want {
	return o
}

-- gneg/go.mod --
module example/gneg

go 1.27

require example/sl v0.0.0

replace example/sl => ../sl

-- gneg/main.go --
package main

import "example/sl"

type Mut struct {
	S []int
}

func (m Mut) Name() sl.Token {
	m.S[0] = 1
	return sl.Token{Text: "mut"}
}

func main() {
	m := Mut{S: []int{1}}
	var q sl.Qual = m
	println(q.Name().Text)
}
